title: Fresh everyday-life regenerative sensing after hidden-asset demotion
objective: Restart from ordinary life with a white active portfolio and search for large/replenishing actor populations with complementary state disequilibria, repeated real leakage, a non-generic recurring boundary problem and a natural demand/event pump. Do not start from products, jobs, gigs, marketplaces or buyer budgets.
truth_rules: PUBLIC PROGRAM SUCCESS != PRIVATE ORCHESTRATION ECONOMICS
PLATFORM NORMALIZATION CAN DESTROY AN APPARENT ROUTING GAP
ONE RETAINED FORMATION ZONE != PROMOTED OPPORTUNITY

portfolio_before_scan.preserved_calibration_family: YOUNG × RETIRED / LOW-AGE OLDER ADULTS × EVERYDAY LIFE

formation_zones.actor_a: young adults with meaningful urban housing-cost or housing-stability pressure
formation_zones.actor_b: older-adult living/eldercare environments with companionship demand and/or underused residential capacity
formation_zones.observed_exchange: youth receive discounted or free accommodation in exchange for bounded non-professional companionship/volunteer contribution

evidence.fact: Shanghai Civil Affairs explicitly recognizes the combined pressures of eldercare-institution utilization imbalance, youth housing cost/commuting pressure and older residents' non-professional companionship needs; it is studying a municipal intergenerational-co-living digital platform and encouraging enterprise participation.

Changzhou Wujin's Qiyuan Qingshe program admits 22–40 year old youth; 20 volunteer hours per month can exchange for a free standard room and 10 hours for half-price accommodation. The mechanism was still operating in September 2026.

Suzhou Civil Affairs publicized a 25-year-old participant paying RMB 200 per month while providing less than four hours of volunteer service per week, showing strong youth-side salience and an already-operating exchange rather than a hypothetical pairing.
Jinyun's intergenerational co-residence program had accumulated 82 dynamic youth residents, 20 currently resident, 6,246 volunteer hours and RMB 208,200 of rent reduction by March 2026.

A 2025 Jinyun case study reports 28 youth, 2,376 volunteer hours and expansion to other subsidiaries, while also recording background-check, management, schedule, lifestyle, language and retention problems.

A 2026 Xuzhou student field study across three eldercare institutions reports high older-adult acceptance and independently surfaces safety guarantees, service-exchange standards and shared-space rules as implementation concerns.
evidence.evidence_role: weak/local exploratory signal; not sufficient for promotion

why_retained: the exchange has repeated across multiple cities and institutions
the pressure exists before founder sales
the value flow is not merely an imagined complementarity
the exchange combines housing capacity, time/companionship and belonging rather than a single explicit gig

youth: lower and more stable housing cost
meaningful low-intensity contribution without becoming a care worker
older_adult_or_institution: more frequent ordinary human contact and social vitality
better utilization of suitable underused residential space
younger-age participation in non-professional community life

counterevidence_and_kill_risks: government and eldercare institutions may normalize the model directly, reducing room for an independent orchestration layer
the current exchange is often volunteer/public-interest oriented rather than market-priced
background checks, duty boundaries, emergency handling, lifestyle conflict and retention create real operating cost
housing discounts may be economically supported by institution/public resources and therefore cannot be treated as private gross margin
youth participation can be sensitive to time burden and rules
companionship must not drift into unqualified care labor or substitute for professional staffing
not_yet_evidenced: an observed recurring missing edge that remains open after current institutions adapt
a private payer with repeatable willingness to pay
whether institution capacity is sufficiently underused and legally convertible at meaningful density
whether a household/private-home variant has comparable real leakage
formation_zones.next_test: Run recursive causal descent on the institution-based exchange first. Compare competing explanations: housing-price disequilibrium, institutional capacity utilization, elder social-companionship deficit, or trust/responsibility boundary. Only after the governing constraint is evidenced should the system search for an inter-node missing edge.

evidence.fact: Nanjing reports 1,300+ mutual-care stations covering more than 99% of communities, 94,000 registered volunteers, 1.47 million service orders and 920,000 stored service hours.
National 2026 policy defines mutual eldercare as voluntary, non-profit help among neighbors/community residents.

formation_zones.verdict: Strong proof that regenerative circulation can exist, but the primary mechanism is explicitly community/public-interest and non-profit. Do not misclassify it as an open private commercial river.

evidence.fact: Shanghai's official parking system supports online discovery and contracting for off-peak shared parking; by end-2024 the city reported 44,000 shared spaces.
In 2026 Shanghai districts continue routing residents to apply for off-peak shared road parking directly through the Shanghai Parking app.

formation_zones.verdict: The bilateral time-shifted parking mismatch is real, but discovery/signing/fulfilment is already being normalized as public digital infrastructure. Generic routing adds little unique edge.

evidence.fact: Shanghai is building integrated elder-service data/platform infrastructure and expanding searchable service/capacity/quality information plus supply-demand matching models.

formation_zones.verdict: Remote-family coordination and fragmented elder services remain real frictions, but a generic booking/dispatch/matching layer is being institutionalized. Any private residual must be evidenced after this adaptation, not assumed.

evidence.fact: The 2026 national green-consumption action explicitly supports online appointment recycling, home pickup, a unified recycling platform, internet-enabled secondhand commerce, consignment and community flea markets.

formation_zones.verdict: Idle household goods are a real resource pool, but current policy and market channels already expand discovery, pickup and resale. Generic neighborhood recirculation is not retained.

cross_scan_verdict.interpretation: Fresh life-world sensing did not produce a business to launch. It produced one empirically repeated bilateral exchange that deserves causal descent before any missing-edge or business claim.

requirements: separate youth latent outcome from stated low-rent request
separate older-adult companionship outcome from staffing shortage
separate institution capacity-utilization motive from elder outcome
generate competing structural causes rather than jump to trust/platform/product
identify whether the accepted causal frontier is intervention-relevant and decision-stable
do not promote a missing edge until structural truth is evidenced
do not design product, pricing or outreach
